submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 at a threshold of 40 GeV is recommended because it achieves the maximum signal efficiency of 90.848% among all tested algorithm-threshold combinations within the allowed range. This efficiency significantly exceeds Algorithm-L1's peak performance of 85.61% (at 30 GeV) by 5.2 percentage points, and outperforms Algorithm-L3's peak of 73.597% (at 40 GeV) by 17.3 percentage points. The 40 GeV threshold falls within the specified constraints (20-60 GeV) and represents the optimal operating point for Algorithm-L2, meeting the goal of achieving the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L2 is one of the three candidate algorithms (L1, L2, L3) evaluated in the simulation.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware
requirements.evidence: All three algorithms including L2 were simulated and evaluated as viable candidates for Level-1 trigger deployment.
The recommended threshold of 40 GeV falls within the specified range [20, 60] GeV.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L2 at 40 GeV achieves 90.848% efficiency, which is the maximum efficiency among all algorithm-threshold combinations tested (L1: 85.61% at 30 GeV, L3: 73.597% at 40 GeV).
